description: This script manages detection and listing of changed extensions in a Git repository, including resolving base revisions, detecting changed paths, and identifying extension IDs based on directory structure and package presence.

methods.name: runGit
methods.description: Executes a git command with specified arguments and options, returning stdout as UTF-8 string.

methods.name: normalizeRelative
methods.description: Converts a given file path to a normalized string with forward slashes.

methods.name: hasGitCommit
methods.description: Checks if a given git reference or commit hash exists in the repository.

methods.name: resolveChangedPathsBase
methods.description: Resolves the base revision to compare against, considering fallbacks and merge bases.

methods.name: listChangedPaths
methods.description: Lists files changed between the base and head revisions.

methods.name: hasExtensionPackage
methods.description: Checks if a given extension directory contains a package.json file.

methods.name: listAvailableExtensionIds
methods.description: Lists all extension IDs that have a package.json in their directory under the extensions root.

methods.name: detectChangedExtensionIds
methods.description: Determines affected extension IDs based on changed file paths.

methods.name: listChangedExtensionIds
methods.description: Lists extension IDs that have changed compared to a base revision or according to specified behavior.
